# Crystal cluster: five glowing six-sided crystals leaning out of a rock (1.1 m across, 1.0 m tall). Static.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.259 0.431 0.365 --no-slot
material new Crystal --base-color 0.984 0.969 0.953 --emission 0.984 0.969 0.953 --no-slot
material new CrystalTan --base-color 0.898 0.690 0.514 --emission 0.898 0.690 0.514 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Base --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.45 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 1.2 1 0.6
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 2
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh uv-sphere --name C0 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 2.885
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0 0 0.500
material assign Crystal
add mesh uv-sphere --name C1 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 2.115
apply --scale
set rotation 20 25 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.3 0.1 0.420
material assign CrystalTan
add mesh uv-sphere --name C2 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 2.308
apply --scale
set rotation 10 -28 0
apply --rotation
set location -0.32 0.05 0.440
material assign Crystal
add mesh uv-sphere --name C3 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 1.731
apply --scale
set rotation -30 10 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.1 -0.25 0.380
material assign CrystalTan
add mesh uv-sphere --name C4 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 1.923
apply --scale
set rotation 28 -10 0
apply --rotation
set location -0.12 0.28 0.400
material assign Crystal
select C0 C2 C4
active C0
join
rename C0 Crystals
select C1 C3
active C1
join
rename C1 CrystalsTan
select all
shade flat
export crystals.glb
